fields.value: Make experiment report pages readable without per-experiment patching

Make experiment report pages readable without per-experiment patching

## Problem

Making manabot's live frontier report (MTG-267, experiment tla_frontier) usable meant patching Etude's rendered HTML and page data from outside the SDK (etude-sdk 0.2.x). Every patch below is a gap in the SDK, not something specific to that experiment.

1. **Metric index memory.** The cumulative training index repeats each metric's description in every block. With about 108k metric names, one index reached 1.3 GB of JSON and parsing it took about 14 GB. The workaround read one block's metadata at a time and kept only the metrics the report declares (about 400 MB).
2. **Refresh.** `render(refresh=...)` reloads the open page on a timer, and the obvious live loop re-reads storage every interval, which costs egress. A live page needs refresh on demand (a refresh action, with concurrent requests joining one generation) and no timer by default.
3. **Config default.** The Config control defaults to the lexically first config, even when that config has no results. All of the charts then showed "Nothing recorded".
4. **Selection fallback.** A panel naming only a tag resolves to the first tournament carrying that tag, even when another tournament holds the results. It should prefer a selection with results.
5. **One line per job across selections.** `Curve` takes a single `Matches`. When each job has its own tag (e.g. `half-training-w64` / `half-training-w160l8`), there's no way to draw one chart with a line per job. A panel should accept several selections, or a tag pattern, and union their cells.
6. **Mirrored head-to-head.** In a two-job head-to-head chart, both subjects draw a line, and one line is just the other's complement. A panel should be able to name which side to show.
7. **Labels.** Job labels are the launch `job_name · N seed`, with no display name. Eval tooltips read `0.625 [0.5313–0.7191] … 64 rows · 16 matches`. Wanted instead: author display names for jobs, values to sensible precision, a named interval ("95% interval 0.53–0.72"), and counts in the score table's units (games).
8. **Section controls that do nothing.** The Matches picker and the section subtitle still show when every panel names its own matches, so they change nothing visible. Hide them in that case.
9. **Configured curves.** The report injected a figure of configured learning-rate/damping schedules into ML, with the current position from update clocks. There was no panel kind for configured, non-observed series.

## Outcome

A report spec like the frontier one renders the following with no post-processing: four eval charts (two with one line per model size, two head-to-head charts with one line), readable labels, no dead controls, refresh on demand, and bounded memory with large metric vocabularies. Each item above gets a directed test.

The workaround script is in the manabot checkout `manabot.c5fba4-frontier-self-play` at `.runs/c5fba4-operator/live_report.py` and `report_training.py`, for reference only. Follow-up adoption in manabot is a separate manabot Task.
